description: Recent US Congress stock trades — who in Congress bought/sold what, with amount ranges and disclosure dates. Pass a ticker to get the trade history for that company instead ("Congress trades for TSLA"). Example: quiver_congress_trading({ ticker: "NVDA", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Quiver Quantitative API key (get one at quiverquant.com; Hobbyist plan from $30/mo)

ticker.description: Optional stock ticker to filter to one company, e.g. "NVDA". Omit for the latest cross-market feed.

name: quiver_congress_trading
